run_train_dreambooth_lora_sdxl: run the DreamBooth LoRA training script for SDXL with instance images and prompts via argparse CLI
create_dreambooth_dataset: create a DreamBoothDataset that loads instance and class images with custom prompts and applies image transforms
build_lora_config_unet: build a LoraConfig for the UNet targeting attention layers with configurable rank, dropout, and DoRA support
run_validation_inference: run validation inference with a StableDiffusionXLPipeline logging generated images to tensorboard or wandb
save_model_card_hub: save a model card with gallery images, trigger words, and usage instructions then push to Hugging Face Hub
